limitations.note: The agent correctly fixed the counter’s handshake but also removed the `ready_b` guard, so the first accepted input of a group overwrites `data_out` when downstream is not ready instead of adding to it as the reference does.

The scoreboard restarted the expected sum at zero after every group, so even its backpressure cases validated the agent’s changed behavior rather than checking that the original `ready_b`-dependent behavior was preserved.
